sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Upper parts chestnut, head dark chestnut, antennae, legs and underside of the abdomen yellowish brown. Head oval; ocelli one diameter from the compound eyes; fenestra narrow and inconspicuous; antenna 15-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2; clypeus hardly projecting. Pronotum about half as long as wide, anterior margin nearly straight and slightly raised, the anterolateral corners rounded and slightly curved downward, the posterolateral corners nearly straight; posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum rather wide, slightly concave; fore wing buds larger than the hind wing buds. Queen body length 12 mm, the tergites strongly arched (especially at the base), secondary chitinization slight, the lateral epidermis of the abdomen with minute pigment dots and setae.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 4 mm; head black, thorax and abdomen dark blackish brown, tarsi pale, the abdomen pale yellowish brown in some individuals (possibly young ones). Head width 0.8 mm. Antenna 3 mm long, 14-segmented, segment 3 twice as long as segment 2, the following segments progressively longer, segment 8 about three times as long as wide. Rostrum large, its anterior surface forming a distinct curve with the anterior surface of the head; vestigial mandibles clearly visible; postmentum less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe short, very slightly raised; hind femora extending beyond the end of the abdomen; abdominal papillae absent.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body length 5 mm; head chestnut, thorax and abdomen dark brown; antenna 15-segmented; hind legs extending beyond the end of the abdomen; abdomen large, oval, the tergites arched.

note: Adapted from the original species-level description by Haviland (1898), original in English; includes imago, queen, soldier and worker, with measurements in mm. The original gives "Hab. Malay Peninsula (Singapore). Type, No. 102"; the nest was spherical, about 10 feet up on a shrub branch.
